title: User Guide
text: Species traits community usually specified giving separate value trait species. Instead, experiment usually defines distribution species-level trait generated. many trait fields appear set three related specifications: mean range distribution mean central value trait distribution. example, birth_optimum_mean 20, birth-rate thermal optima centred around 20 degrees. range total spread trait values around mean. range 4 means generated values drawn placed across mean +/- 0.5 * range. mean 20 range 4, trait values come interval 18 22. distribution defines species-level values chosen within range. two main trait distributions : "regular": species assigned evenly spaced trait values across interval.
